name: fluid-mcp-server

tools.name: fluid_get_all_ftokens
tools.description: List all fToken (Fluid lending token) addresses on a chain. fTokens are ERC4626-compliant and represent a user's share in the lending pool.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_ftoken_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific fToken including name, symbol, underlying asset, supply rate, rewards rate, total assets, and total supply.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_all_ftokens_details
tools.description: Get details for ALL fTokens on a chain in a single call — names, rates, TVL, and underlying assets. Perfect for a lending dashboard.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_user_lending_position
tools.description: Get a user's position in a specific fToken lending pool. Returns fToken shares, underlying asset value, wallet balance, and allowance.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_user_all_positions
tools.description: Get all of a user's lending positions across all fTokens on a chain. Returns combined fToken details and user position data.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_previews
tools.description: Get conversion previews for deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem operations on an fToken. Useful for estimating output before transacting.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

assets.description: Comma-separated list of asset amounts to preview (in raw units)

shares.description: Comma-separated list of share amounts to preview (in raw units)

tools.name: fluid_get_all_vaults
tools.description: List all Fluid vault addresses on a chain. Returns vault addresses and their types (T1, T2, T3, T4).

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_vault_type
tools.description: Get the type of a specific vault (T1, T2, T3, or T4). T1=10000, T2=20000, T3=30000, T4=40000.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_vault_data
tools.description: Get comprehensive data for a specific Fluid vault: supply/borrow tokens with symbols, rates as APY, human-readable collateral factor, liquidation threshold, LTV limits, total supply/borrow, and availability limits.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_vault_position
tools.description: Get a specific vault position by its NFT ID. Each Fluid vault position is represented as an NFT. Returns decoded supply (collateral), borrow (debt) in human-readable token amounts, liquidation status, vault config, and rates.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_user_vault_nft_ids
tools.description: Get all vault position NFT IDs owned by a specific user address.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_vault_by_nft
tools.description: Get the vault address and decoded position summary for a specific vault position NFT ID.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_get_total_positions
tools.description: Get the total number of vault positions (NFTs) across all vaults on a chain.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_deposit
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to deposit assets into a Fluid fToken lending pool. Returns the transaction data that must be signed and sent by the agent's wallet. Uses the ERC4626 deposit() method.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

ftoken_address.description: fToken contract address to deposit into

amount.description: Amount of underlying assets to deposit (in raw units / wei)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the fToken shares

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_mint
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to mint a specific number of fToken shares by depositing underlying assets.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

shares.description: Number of fToken shares to mint (in raw units)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the fToken shares

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_withdraw
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw underlying assets from a Fluid fToken lending pool. Burns fToken shares in exchange for underlying assets.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

amount.description: Amount of underlying assets to withdraw (in raw units)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the underlying assets

owner.description: Address that owns the fToken shares (usually same as receiver)

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_redeem
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to redeem fToken shares for underlying assets. Specify how many shares to burn rather than how many assets to receive.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

shares.description: Number of fToken shares to redeem (in raw units)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the underlying assets

owner.description: Address that owns the fToken shares

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_deposit_native
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to deposit native ETH into a Fluid fToken lending pool (for ETH-based fTokens). No approval needed.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

ftoken_address.description: fToken contract address (must be a native ETH fToken)

amount.description: Amount of ETH to deposit (in wei)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the fToken shares

tools.name: fluid_build_lending_withdraw_native
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw native ETH from a Fluid fToken lending pool.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

amount.description: Amount of ETH to withdraw (in wei)

receiver.description: Address that will receive the ETH

owner.description: Address that owns the fToken shares

tools.name: fluid_build_token_approve
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to approve an ERC20 token for spending by a Fluid contract (fToken, vault, DEX pool). Required before deposit/supply operations.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

spender.description: Address to approve (fToken, vault, or pool address)

amount.description: Amount to approve in raw units. Defaults to max uint256 (unlimited).

tools.name: fluid_build_vault_t1_operate
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to interact with a Vault T1 (single-asset collateral, single-asset debt). T1 operate function is payable.

chain.description: Blockchain network. Supported: ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma

nft_id.description: Position NFT ID (0 to open new position)

new_col.description: Collateral change in raw units (negative to withdraw, use INT256_MIN to close)

new_debt.description: Debt change in raw units (negative to repay, use INT256_MIN to close)

receiver.description: Address to receive withdrawn collateral or borrowed tokens
